# Vendored test dependencies

Plain copies of pinned release tarballs (not submodules). Licenses kept in each directory.

| Project | Tag | Upstream |
|---------|-----|----------|
| bats-core | v1.14.0 | https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core |
| bats-support | v0.3.0 | https://github.com/bats-core/bats-support |
| bats-assert | v2.2.4 | https://github.com/bats-core/bats-assert |

Run tests: `vendor/bats-core/bin/bats test/bats`
